app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.

get.description: Lists page titles on one Liquipedia wiki using MediaWiki list=allpages. Supports source namespace, prefix/range, redirect, language-link, size, protection, ordering, page-size, and continuation filters. Use liquipedia_enums for namespace and closed filter values. Results include Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.

get.description: Returns pages that transclude a source-selected page through MediaWiki list=embeddedin. With an infobox template such as Template:Infobox league, Template:Infobox team or Template:Infobox player it enumerates every tournament, team or player page on a wiki; discover template titles with liquipedia_all_pages (apnamespace=10). Supports namespace and redirect filters, ascending or descending order, page limits of 1-500 or max, and native continuation. Returned page records include their Liquipedia page URLs and CC BY-SA 3.0 attribution metadata.

get.description: Returns the current set of Liquipedia wiki prefixes and canonical wiki URLs from the Commons MediaWiki interwiki map. Use a returned wiki slug with liquipedia_enums, liquipedia_search, liquipedia_category_members, and liquipedia_page. Results include Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.

Returns the raw wikitext of Liquipedia pages through MediaWiki prop=revisions (not action=parse, so it is not bound by the 30-second parse pacing). Provide exactly one selector type: up to 50 titles, up to 50 page IDs, or up to 50 revision IDs. rvprop adds revision metadata such as ids, timestamp, user, comment, size, sha1, tags and flagged; content is always included. rvsection returns one section. For one title or page ID the history fields (rvlimit 1-50, rvstartid, rvendid, rvstart, rvend, rvdir, rvuser, rvexcludeuser, rvtag) list older revisions with their content. infobox=true adds each revision's top-level Infobox template parameters (for example Infobox league prizepoolusd, sdate, edate, liquipediatier, organizer) as raw, unnormalized wikitext values next to the unchanged content. Missing titles are returned with missing=true. Native continuation, page URLs, Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata are preserved.
